admission.justification: The selected-value contract must agree between the core role/document/agent selectors and the separate host feature renderer; a truncated display without complete hover loses the user-selected identity.

applicability: Chosen-or-default values of the shared launcher role, agent, model, effort and selectable-feature selectors; matched selected document options, with the explicit purpose-only branch when a document optionIndex is empty or unmatched.
conditions: Non-document default and explicit/foreign-agent override labels retain their complete display text, purpose and applicable provenance in hover, including default sentinel values.
A matched selected document option retains its complete document label, purpose and canonical identity in hover.
An empty or unmatched document optionIndex returns only its purpose (Sprint, Master or Task); it does not repeat the visible empty placeholder or assert a document identity.
exclusions: Changing offered choices, dispatch payloads or permission resolution.
Execution/reply prose, which must not be restored as hover text.
Requiring placeholder recovery or document identity for empty or unmatched document selectors; their hover is purpose-only.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/RoleLauncher.row.test.tsx (15 tests: defaults-hover labels, override-hover labels incl. long model label and foreign agent Eve, document title+identity); RoleChats.launcher.test.tsx R71 chip+hover assertions green.

statement: Launcher role, agent, model, effort and selectable-feature hovers retain their complete chosen-or-default label, purpose and applicable default provenance. Document-selector hovers retain the complete label, purpose and canonical identity for a matched selected option; an empty or unmatched optionIndex instead names only the purpose (Sprint, Master or Task), not the visible placeholder or an identity. Hover treatment changes neither offered choices nor dispatch payloads, disabled-state policy or permission policy; separately ruled product-held naming and occupancy retain their runtime owner.
